key.name: show
key.summary: Shortcut(s) to open the Window Picker
key.description: Accelerator(s) that trigger the window picker popup. Use syntax like '<Super>Y' or '<Super><Shift>W'. Multiple accelerators can be specified.

key.name: show-app-bar
key.description: When enabled, displays an app icon bar grouped by window count to filter the list.

key.name: enable-move-popover
key.description: When enabled, rows include a move button that opens the monitor placement popover.

key.name: show-dev-dir-tab
key.description: When enabled, adds a tab to show recent development directories.
